text:
anya: Quick Q  planning to do a 10-week writing retreat in the Azores (Sao Miguel) from 2026-09-01 -> 2026-11-09. It's basically remote work + time zone shift. Need to confirm: 1) WFH stipend handling (pro-rate?) 2) Any Canada/US/Portugal tax or benefits implications I should be aware of? 3) Can IT ship a noise-canceling headset to the guesthouse? 4) Do I update homebase or file temp remote?
maria (people-ops): Love this! :ocean: Short answers: stipend = pro-rated by days in the month for temporary trips; don't change homebase for <6 months; submit Temp Remote form and mark international.
dmitri (payroll): We'll need exact dates/location to estimate any withholding. Portugal can tax nonresidents working there in some circumstances; for short stays it's usually not company-level nexus but you could have personal tax residency rules if you exceed 183 days over a rolling window. I'll open a ticket once form is in.
anya: Got it. I'm not crossing 183 days. Dates again: 2026-09-01 to 2026-11-09. Guesthouse address below.
```
Anya Kapoor
Casa do Mar, Rua da Ribeira 12
Ribeira Grande, Sao Miguel 9600-301
Azores, Portugal
```
elaine (benefits): Health plan note: US-based medical doesn't cover local Portuguese providers. If you expect to see a doctor there, open an international claim and DM me first. Consider short-term travel insurance if you'll be away from US for >30 days. Also, EAP and telehealth still OK.
samir (legal): Legal note: For Portugal, if you provide services while physically present, there can be payroll withholding or reporting obligations depending on duration and whether local authorities consider economic nexus. For ~10 weeks, low company risk, but payroll should confirm withholding handling and whether we need to file any forms with local authorities. Also check visa rules for remote work in Portugal.
alex (it): We can ship a headset, yes. For international shipping we need manager approval + signed equipment waiver that acknowledges customs risks. Shipping ETA ~7-12 business days. If you prefer buying locally and filing expense, we can reimburse per policy.
anya: Thanks. Is the stipend amount the same for international? I'd expect higher coffee/coworking costs.
maria (people-ops): Stipend is same baseline globally; exceptions for long-term relocations exist but not for short temp trips. We can provide coworking credits case-by-case; file a ticket with receipts and tag Benefits.
dmitri (payroll): Ticket PR-5120 created to estimate Portugal withholding and stipend proration. ETA 48-72 hours. We'll flag if any payroll tax withholding is needed.
payroll-bot: PR-5120 created by payroll-bot  will send email once estimates ready.
anya: I've submitted the Temp Remote form and selected "international" + shipping checkbox. Waiver signed and attached.
dmitri (payroll): Received. Early estimate: stipend proration for Sept = $110.00, Oct = $300.00 (full month), Nov = $110.00 (pro-rated) -> final numbers after payroll calc. Withholding unlikely but possible; we'll confirm by EOD.
elaine (benefits): If you buy local travel insurance, ping me and i'll add it to your record for easy claims.
maria (people-ops): Thanks team. Anya, enjoy the Azores 30a and ping if visa/immigration questions come up. We'll post final payroll numbers into this thread when available.
anya: Amazing, thank you all! :heart:
